rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Staff-level analog-mixed-signal IC design for AI inference accelerators, owning circuits for an in-memory-compute engine and a die-to-die serial interface from schematic through silicon bring-up.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering AND 5+ years of related professional experience in high-speed circuit design.
- Experience with schematic capture, SPICE simulation, and Monte Carlo simulation.
- Experience with circuit layout, extraction, and back-annotated simulation.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Deep expertise in SerDes verification and characterization, including analog verification infrastructure, process-node migration, or reliability analysis.
- Deep expertise in clocking and CDR, including ownership of a low-jitter PLL, phase interpolator, or CDR loop through silicon at 25 Gbps+ per lane.
- Deep expertise in TX/RX datapath design, equalization, or PAM4/DSP-based receiver architectures.
- Deep expertise in die-to-die interconnect, familiarity with relevant specifications, or standards body participation.
- Experience with channel modeling using MATLAB or similar tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
